title_en: In the Courtroom (8/20): The Fake Investment Scam
note_en: 从来没有…过 is the strongest way to say "have never (ever) done": 从来 means "at any time up to now," and 没有…过 negates past experience, so 他从来没有真正投资过这些钱 means he never once actually invested the money. Note that 从来 almost always appears with a negative; English "always" is 总是 or 一直, not 从来.
